notes: Hermes fan-out via delegate_task's batch `tasks` array (default max_concurrent_children=3, unset in config). RE-ASSESSED on current code: commit 6ad7c28a widened BOTH source predicates (watcher.go scanSessions and metrics.go querySessionMetrics) to `source IN ('cli','tui','subagent')`, so a delegate child — INSERTed into the shared state.db `sessions` table at turn setup with parent_session_id = the parent's session id — now surfaces as a child session (transcript_new) carrying ParentSessionID, parent_linked fires, and SubagentCount(parent) tracks the live fan-out via ComputeSubagentSummary's ParentSessionID match. The known_failing marking of the previous pass is REMOVED. Unlike claudecode there is NO transcript file and NO per-run journal file — Hermes' delegation bookkeeping is an `async_delegations` TABLE inside state.db plus human-readable live transcripts under cache/delegation/live/ — so no phantom 'journal'/'unknown' session can arise, and no sweep phase (transcript_removed) is emittable: the 'SubagentCount returns to 0' criterion is covered indirectly by the parent's final ready with no active child. The parent's own turn always ends early (top-level delegations are forced background), so claudecode's 'no state_transition to ready for parent' invariant is deliberately NOT asserted — holdParentWorkingForNewChild (#889) is what re-holds the parent working once a child is discovered. Observations: tokens only — the recorded model depends on whichever config.yaml the run's HERMES_HOME carries, so record fills observations.model (and cost_nonzero if that model is priced).

text: The parent hermes session appears in ready shortly after launch (expected to be the transient proc-<PID> pre-session — the store row is INSERTed only on the first user message), left UNPINNED so the pre-session cannot steal identity
A PID is bound to the parent session (hermes is a Python console script, matched on the full command line)
The fan-out prompt drives the parent ready -> working (acceptance: parent ready -> working when the fan-out starts)
A delegate child surfaces as its own session — its `sessions` row is INSERTed at turn setup by run_agent._ensure_db_session with source='subagent', which scanSessions now admits

The detector binds child.session_id -> parent.session_id from the row's parent_session_id (acceptance: children are subagents of the parent, never top-level sessions; SubagentCount(parent) tracks the live count, peaking at ~3)
The parent is working while the delegate children run — either still in its own turn or re-held by holdParentWorkingForNewChild after the always-background dispatch briefly let it go ready
The parent returns to ready only after the last child has ended and no active child remains (reevaluateParent); the children have transitioned working -> ready as they finished
